status_note: Reproduces on 55.0.0, the latest release. No upstream issue found (searched the Substrait consumer's join handling). Main not checked. sverify's #98 has the first report.
title: The Substrait consumer takes an equality of two columns of one join input for a join key
summary: An inner join whose condition has an `=` between two columns of the same input, next to the real key (`a.k = b.k AND a.k = a.x`), fails in the Substrait consumer: it takes every `=` conjunct for an equi-join key pair without checking which side each column comes from. The SQL runs.
repro: The Substrait plan (Lean's `--write`) of `select count(*) from a join b on a.k = b.k and a.k = a.x` fails with `type_coercion caused by Schema error: No field named a.x. Valid fields are b.k, b.y.` (55.0.0; 51.0.0 `FieldNotFound`).
handling: `--write-datafusion` moves conjuncts over one input into a filter on that input (an inner join's left side) or writes them as a `CASE` (`Write.writeRel`, #98).
found_by: audit of DataFusion's limits on the shared path (2026-11-08)
